newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese bonds gain but lose ground on Bund.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese bonds gain but lose ground on Bund.

text.p: 1645 GMT - Bonds rose but lost some ground on the German Bunds ahead of the long weekend. But traders expected the spread to narrow again on Monday. *Sept 97 up 24 at 110.24 vs Wednesday close *Feb 07 cash (OTC) 101.60 vs 101.48. Yld 6.39 vs 6.40 *Spread vs 10-yr cash Bund 73 bps vs 70 bps
